note: Wooded family campground east of Angola, one of the iCampIndiana group, with a swimming pond, sandy beach and fishing pond; overnight and seasonal sites. --Claude
summary: $45-55 confirmed; season mid-Apr to mid-Oct, operator booking, 160 sites, 50A/water, pull-throughs, facilities added; note cleaned. Reader says a lot of seasonals; share not stated. Not waterfront stands; pin fine.
flags: SEASONAL / long-stay tests: 'Daily, weekly and monthly camping' and 'plenty of overnight and weekend camping sites'; seasonal 'starting at only $2,200' with 'Come pick your site now for the 2027 Camping Season'. The map numbers about 160 sites without marking which are seasonal, and no page gives the split. A Google review, 4 years ago: 'The place has a lot of seasonals.' Can't say it's mostly seasonal; borderline read, as with Atwood Lake (same owner group).
GATE: rate posted ($45 W/E, under $50; $55 with holiday surcharge or pull-through). Own booking form. Google 4.3/110. gateways.py: none within 40 km. Site and phone 260-665-5166 live.
SEWER LEAD: review, 4 years ago: 'They don't have sewer hookups... the dump station was fine.' Park lists only 'Water and electric'; not written (silence).

REVIEWS: mixed-to-good: 'spacious and well shaded' (a year ago); 'pleased with... the size of the lots' (edited a year ago); 'the camp could use a little work' (10 years ago). Site length unposted; a pull-through tier exists. The map shows vault toilets through the loops and a single bath house, 'far away from my campsite' (4 years).
INTERSTATE: I-69 passes about 400 m southwest of the pin on imagery; a reviewer calls it 'located close to the highway'. Wooded buffer between. Not a criteria issue, just a fact.

WATER: only the park's own swimming pond (~1.5 acres on imagery; sites 143-159 around it) and a fishing pond. 'not waterfront' stands despite 'fun on the water' marketing; no re-audit lead. PIN: 41.6417,-84.8244 is mid-grounds on the entrance road: no move.
